programme.desc: It's time to get tiny for some a-meow-zing new dollhouse adventures! Hop aboard the S.S. MerCat with Gabby and her friends as they sail to never before seen magical places, meeting new cats at every turn. Go to Mermaid-lantis with MerCat and her sister SunnyCat, build a rainbow igloo at the North Pole, and welcome Baby Box Cat’s new little brother to the dollhouse family. They may not have all the answers...'Yet!', but the Gabby Cats are always ready to give it a go! Bringing together adorable kitties, dollhouse play, growth mindset, music, crafts, and laughs; Gabby's Dollhouse is the preschool show... with a surprise inside.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN! Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.desc: 《730 玩返轉》小阮體驗泰國規模最大的互動螢幕，結合科技與藝術的視覺震撼，再品嚐曼谷神級甜品「泰式奶茶千層糕」，層層香甜令人回味。Jessica分享她由辦公室出走、展開數碼游牧生活的起點，並推薦多個適合遠距工作的國家與城市。Uppacase走訪別府街頭一間由老字號洋行變身而成的特色咖啡店，復古空間中飄散現代咖啡香.

programme.title: 背著善宰跑
programme.desc: 任率為了拯救善宰，她決定與他成為朋友，但成為朋友並不容易。善宰在比賽中奪得金牌，他決定向任率坦白自己的感情.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 一副眼鏡除了功能重要，設計也能完全改變用家的風格。今集主持訪問設計師配對計劃裏的單位，聽聽他們如何合作.

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 730 玩返轉
programme.sub-title: 上海英式餐廳｜九州空中遊樂園
programme.desc: 《730 玩返轉》CK品嚐上海英式餐廳的經典菜餚，再到訪由韓國時尚集團開設的中國實體店，感受跨國潮流美學的碰撞。Jessica細說她到訪埃及金字塔與俄羅斯紅場的震撼體驗，從古文明到極地風光，旅程充滿驚奇。Uppacase帶觀眾體驗九州最古老的空中遊樂園，在雲端俯瞰壯麗景致，刺激與美景並存.

programme.title: 8點直樂 VIURIETY
programme.desc: 《8 點直樂 VIURIETY》為 1.5 小時綜藝節目，集娛樂、資訊、遊戲等不同元素於一身，送上多元而精彩的綜藝環節！星期一至五每晚都有獨特主題，包括 Food Night、The Choose Day、Men’s Challenge Night、Music Night 及 Play Hard Night。每一集主持、藝員及嘉賓傾力演出外，還有豐富獎金獎品送給全港觀眾，務求與大家共渡可能是最有玩味性的綜藝時光.

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 日落下的彩虹
programme.desc: 斌哥斌嫂來到律師樓簽紙離婚，還未落筆，卻反而落淚。Windy和腎仔及時拉走父母，保住了這段婚姻，更終於得知二人離婚原委，原來源於多年前的一場背叛……夫妻離婚不成，卻繼續在街坊面前演恩愛，激怒 Windy直指二人逃避問題最可恥！在子女影響下，斌哥斌嫂終於嘗試正面面對，在婚姻諮詢室內，第一次真正敞開心屝，訴說內心傷痛。兩人硬著頭皮重新拍拖，意圖拾回昔日感覺。就在一切看似有好轉時，卻才發現，原來那根尖刺，仍是一碰就痛….

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 跳祭少女放飛假期
programme.desc: 祭典前夕，兩位跳祭少女先去到世羅高原農場，一探壯麗花海如何鍊成，再深入原始森林，展開一場驚險百出嘅「叢林歷奇大冒險」，深刻體會大自然值得敬畏嘅威力。隨後，旅程迎來最核心、最神聖一刻！兩位少女獲准提早進入熊野毛筆祭現場，親手參與最關鍵嘅前期祭祀儀式——為現場掛上神聖嘅毛筆，也是兩位主持第一次真正落手接觸祭典的幕後靈魂.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 講玄
programme.desc: 本節目將以全新方式探討玄學議題，旨在打破傳統框架，提供多元視角。主持 人達哥（林慧韡）、米露迪、Lucas T.（李進偉），從不同角度深入討論與玄學相關的主題。 每集將邀請不同領域的玄學家作為嘉賓，促進激烈且富有深度的觀點交流，在 理性數據分析的支持下，挑戰迷信並鼓勵觀眾獨立思考。不僅吸引對神秘學感興趣的 觀眾，亦針對喜愛邏輯分析與觀點辯論的人群，提供豐富的內容。 討論主題將緊貼都市熱話，易於引發社交媒體上的討論並激起大眾共鳴。透過 這樣的對話，節目旨在滿足觀眾的好奇心，並提供生活指引，幫助觀眾更加明智地面 對生活中的不確定性.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: I SWIM
programme.desc: 中學最後一屆水運會，余浪沖無忘與施詠之間的承諾，接受李馬榮的挑戰，再次參加50米自由泳。多年來亦師亦友的二人，終於成為直接對手，首次正面對決。這場天才與努力的對決，終於有了結果。然而兩人卻因為Miss翁被辭退一事而產生誤會，兄弟決裂。神秘泳手章浩以《冠中》校友的身份向余浪沖下戰書，約戰一場4x50四式接力賽！為迎戰這個被譽為「努力的天才」，余浪沖必需找回擅長蝶泳的李馬榮重組接力隊，眾人的大學生活再起波瀾….

programme.title: 入島日本喇 !
programme.desc: 由福岡來的使節 Shirley (沈殷怡) 登上壱岐島，與 Soko (和泉素行) 和 Kathy (王頌茵) 親嚐神社咖啡店的特色飲料。一探神明居住的無人島之後，一起親嚐極為罕有的「壱岐牛」.

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.desc: Shirley 作為促進亞洲的循環時尚的推動者，與團隊一同協助設計師並希望教育消費者，使循環時尚理念深入人心。每年舉辦活動收集公眾不再穿著的衣物，經由團隊進行篩選和整理。透過創新的「升級再造」設計，這些被回收的衣物能夠轉變為新穎的時裝單品，減少環境負擔，並實現資源的再利用。循環時尚是未來時尚產業的重要趨勢，透過他們的努力，推動社會對環保時尚的認知與重視.

programme.desc: 道赫繼續推進他揭露MATTHEW真實身份的計劃.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 總有一瓣喺左近
programme.desc: 殯儀館又稱為大酒店，喻意先人於人世間的最後一宿。紅磡是香港殯儀館的主要集中地，該區有三間大酒店，每日有不少遺體出入，加上不少往生者聚集，陰氣較易積聚，遇到靈異事件不足為奇.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB 推介
programme.desc: 一首歌背後嘅故事、花咗好多心機嘅MV、歌手同幕後音樂人嘅心血… 《CHILL CLUB 推介》星期一至五晚一於全部都推介俾你.

programme.title: 國色芳華
programme.desc: 何惟芳故意指出穿魚身上的玉佩為玉露所贈，而此玉佩原為陳章送給蔣長揚，蔣長揚則稱其為劉宅管家所贈。管家被迫背負黑鍋，劉申假意懲罰他，杖責後將其逐出劉家。儘管劉申顏面盡失，何惟芳卻認為此舉並非真正報仇.

programme.title: 台灣山步行
programme.desc: 位於台灣南投縣仁愛鄉的清境農場，海拔高達1700公尺，對台灣人來說，這裡也成為了夏天超知名的避暑勝地，有小瑞士稱號。而青青草原近年來最熱們的活動，就是這「牧羊人體驗」!!!戴上牛仔帽、穿上雨鞋，阿妹要化身一日羊褓姆，在這一大片草原裡，將上百隻的羊，全部趕到柵欄裡。騎馬逛清境你恐怕沒嘗過，在充滿異國風情的草原山坡裡，坐在馬背上前進，阿妹覺得自己好像變成皇室貴族了，最後，清境農場最知名的雲南擺夷菜上桌，歷史的因素，讓這邊充滿了許多滇緬料理，吃美食，聽歷史，真的很有趣.

programme.title: 終於飛到LA
programme.desc: 阿妹和 Jessica 來到洛杉磯的梅爾羅斯大街，有大學生最愛的打卡點和潮店，亦有可持續時裝店、二手服裝店，疫情後逛實體服裝店格外興奮，兩位主持還夢想成真，在街上偶遇荷里活電影明星！逛夠買夠，一於到訪由歷史建築改建而成美食廣場和聖塔莫尼卡的沙灘，好好吃一頓美食.

programme.title: 打開你雪櫃
programme.desc: 插畫家 Johnee 古靈精怪，有他出現總會有不幸事發生。Johnee 一家三口，關係各自為政，很少同枱食飯，形容家人為 ”Flatmate” 家中雜物極多，衛生情況欠佳，小谷這次除了一探傳聞中可怕嘅雪櫃之外，仲會進入宅男家中獨特嘅生態圈，教佢煮芝心新豬肉扒，並招呼佢班插畫界朋友.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 超人狄奧
舉頭三尺
programme.sub-title: 新竹普天宮/關公神像篇
programme.desc: Kathy仔與YOYO來到風城新竹尋找大神像，任務在知名新竹城隍廟尋找新竹三寶之二米粉貢丸後，也體驗了玻璃工藝，順利得到線索找到了第二座大神像並據說有個鋼鐵人形象的關公究竟是怎麼回事呢？新竹普天宮鄰近十八尖山、青草湖、清華大學、交通大學，因此每逢假日，逐而形成一條熱門的旅遊路線，高度36米的關公神像最為人津津樂道，神像莊嚴肅穆，是極具規模的關公神像。據說知名科技業龍頭張先生都曾來到這邊祈求公司業務昌盛，許多在科學園區工作的人都會特地到這裡祈求升官發財，聽說相當靈顯喔.

programme.title: 區區都有STEM
programme.desc: 今集，主持Gracey和香港中文大學微生物學博士Dr Helen 前往西營盤西區食品批發市場。由食物實驗著手，製作出食物DNA，並講解當中的原理。二人再去藝里坊觀看街頭壁畫打卡。顏料塗上牆就無法去掉，為什麼白板筆寫在白板上能簡易去除？ 原來白板筆跡還可以浮在水面之上。Dr Helen會跟大家示範當中的原理.

programme.title: 我要爆Show
programme.desc: 三位本台藝人正式踏上「爆Show」之路，包括有元老級藝員 Dixon、一直在演藝事業上拔足狂奔的Pony以及藝能初哥 Thomas。第一位登場的是《戀愛Staycation》出身的Thomas，開始接受挑戰前，作為伯樂的Hailey，會如何忠告他呢？在製作組安排之下，Thomas要完成一日限定店長的任務，他能否勝任並獲得大眾的喜愛呢.

programme.title: 演奏1 TAKE過
programme.desc: Pamade，Kanti，Giying，Cengceng…，以上嘅名稱相信絕大多數香港觀眾都唔認識，其實佢哋都係樂器名，而成組合奏，統稱為Gamelan。Gamelan係來自印尼嘅民族音樂，單單係敲擊樂器就有十幾樣咁多，節奏樂器組更加係林林總總。而學咗十四年嘅Anvy係精通晒全部，佢嘅心願就係希望更多人知道香港都有人玩緊不一樣嘅樂器。不過，鍾情於敲擊樂嘅Anvy原來手部有傷患，醫生話除咗做手術，別無他法..

programme.title: P1X3L 5G 上位計劃
programme.desc: 八位神仙流落凡間，他們不但丟失神位，靈魂更錯落在不同軀殼。經過連串人間任務，眾人總算恢復神力，變回賭神、壽星公、邱比特、南丁格爾、Marco Jackson、女神、豬仔八戒、哮天犬。然而，他們卻要面臨重返天庭前的最後一劫——神仙打交。原來神仙亦須遵從「物競天擇，適者生存」的叢林法則。誅仙大戰，就此展開，誰能成為最後生還者？「物競天擇，適者生存」的叢林法則。誅仙大戰，就此展開，誰能成為最後生還者.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集由PER SE擔任嘉賓，以歌曲《還在拉扯的伏線》為主題，節目中二人更會唱出與主題相關的歌曲。為大家穿梭住愛情之間的拉扯。此外，節目亦設有 「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲.

programme.title: 地獄廚神是我媽
programme.desc: 育有三個小朋友的 Kelly 媽媽只有一年落廚經驗，由於以前是婆婆煮飯和買外買多，所以到自己下廚時，也創出不少黑料理。Kelly 媽媽最喜歡吃全熟牛扒，而且每次一定會煮到變石頭煤炭屎牛扒，令三個仔女忍不住作投訴！研究所今次派出大廚雷啟裕為 Kelly 媽媽進行特訓，為了幫她洗甩「地獄廚神媽媽」之名，雷師傅研發了一個零失敗的煮牛扒方法，又教她如何正確煮炒椰菜花飯，究竟 Kelly 媽媽吸收到幾多，又能否成功洗甩「地獄廚神媽媽」之名.

programme.title: 貓之旅神
programme.desc: 《 貓之旅神》來到最後一集，當然要參觀土耳其著名的聖索菲亞清真寺，Shirley 及Asha為表誠意更特登挑選合適嘅頭巾！接住二人來到有頂大市集，更在大市集上蓋學特務電影007飛檐走壁？！驚慄刺激過後 ，二人就來到了有「最美好的村落」之稱的希林傑村 ，試咖啡占卜，嚐美酒，跟貓一同渡過最悠閒最寫意的旅程.

programme.title: 在絕版前放浪一次
programme.desc: 娟和Chris來到塞舌爾第二大島普拉蘭島，首先到住宿check in，一事卻令兩位連連尖叫，哭笑不得！隨即，他們在大雨下坐公共巴士到島上碩果僅存的椰子油廠，拜訪由生產到銷售全程一腳踢的老闆Francis。免費開放椰子油廠給遊容參觀，對Francis來說有什麼意義？最後，娟和 Chris來到屬世界自然遺產的五月谷國家公園，一睹外型相當奇特，全球只有普拉蘭島獨有的海椰子。這個全世界最大的堅果，到底有多古怪？這個樹林當中，還潛藏了多少瀕臨絕版的動物.

programme.title: 跑住玩
programme.desc: 天草隱世高杢島，非跑不可！睇準潮漲潮退，享受一人之境。感受過寧靜，就轉聽Pony尖叫聲，拍攝「公司冇逼我玩zipline」，激動留淚，換來Inez慈母式安慰，還有美食獎勵，一嚐天草大王雞刺身，大過塊臉雞翼等一級名物.

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥
programme.desc: 今集大玩個人賽，5位主持要憑他們的常識決一高下，有1位主持由頭帶到尾，敗績無人能敵，這位主角是否大家預期之中的那位？去到第2個遊戲，不用再只靠頭腦，完成到任務就有機會勝出，這位主持又能否在這個遊戲反敗為勝呢.

programme.title: 小王子和朋友們
programme.sub-title: 惡作劇小行星 / 太空鬍子

programme.title: 職人小學徒 第3集 -霓虹燈導師 - 陳珮彰
programme.desc: 霓虹燈曾經照亮香港嘅大街小巷，近年霓虹招牌逐漸消失，幸而還有些像迷你霓虹燈導師陳珮彰(Polly)的職人，以新技術將這種充滿香港特色的標誌保存。今集主持同小學徒，就跟Polly老師學習以手作將這片五光十色帶返屋企.

programme.title: 語常會30年：深耕語言路
programme.desc: 語常會推動社會，提升兩文三語能力，嘉年華推廣閱讀，資助非華裔學生學習中文，戲劇表演沉浸式學普通話，介紹語常會成立30年，深耕語言路.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 週六好戲勢: 危城
programme.desc: 時值國家內戰、軍閥割據亂世時代，普城保衛團團長楊克難 (劉青雲 飾) 由於軍閥少帥曹少麟 (古天樂 飾)殺害三條人命，於是將曹少帥繩之於法，可是曹軍財雄勢大，以強權震懾居民，曹軍上校張亦 (吳京 飾)得悉事件後，趕來普城取人，遇上多年不見師弟馬鋒 (彭于晏 飾)。馬鋒是位武功高強的浪人，路見不平欲拔刀相助，可是卻面臨正義與兄弟情之抉擇.

programme.title: 怪獸8號
programme.desc: 三度現身的「怪獸9號」分裂成兩隻，將防衛隊玩弄於鼓掌之中。卡夫卡與奇可露雖齊心迎戰，但面對能在戰鬥中不斷進化的怪獸9號，戰況卻逐漸落於下風，更糟的是，卡夫卡無法順利變身為怪獸8號。陷入絕境的奇可露，回想起與亡母四之宮光曾經立下的約定…。另一方面，鳴海則與另一隻怪獸9號展開了激烈攻防.

programme.title: 狗仔隊亂入Seoul
programme.desc: Dixon和Kathy深入松鼠狗CoCo公主拍攝廣告現場，寵物攝影師品評同場的比熊犬，態度嚴厲，隨後眾人跟隨CoCo公主去After Party.

programme.title: 積極到爆
programme.desc: 俗語話人靠衣裝，打工人如果有張靚仔靚女嘅面容，對佢哋嘅事業都會有幫助。所以修眉師以及化妝師就越來越普及，唔好以為 KB 一個大男人要佢去學習修眉及化妝，就會輸比 Yoshi，結果會令人意想不到.

programme.title: 超低能特攻隊
programme.desc: 6隊員分組，大戰閃避球，勝出組別出線，低分組再玩運波波，手持多個球類跑到終點，最慢2位出局，2輸家1位來自前女子跳舞組合，另1位是曾有不少創舉的viu TV男藝員.

programme.title: 摔角魂
programme.desc: 職業摔角是一種以競技方式進行的表演藝術，過程充分展現摔角手在擂台上的拼勁及雄姿。仿如真實的擂台格鬥，讓觀眾看得熱血沸騰。各個國家的摔角表演，因應當地文化差異而有所不同，亞洲地區以日本摔角發展得最為蓬勃。香港及台灣近年也發展得有聲有色，可謂後起之秀。香港選手何顥麟更成功衝出亞洲，打到美國，正式成為世界摔角最高殿堂WWE的選手，在美國各地巡迴演出。此節目的真正目的是透過香港摔角代表人物「何顥麟」及其團員，向廣大觀眾介紹，摔角到底是一種什麼表演藝術？如何由一名初哥變成擂台好手？過程以「真人騷」形式進行，再配以輕鬆搞笑的故事骨幹及旁白，深入淺出地介紹日本與香港之間的摔角文化及特色。更會詳盡介紹摔角手鮮為人知的一面，擂台英姿、訓練苦況、日常生活...等等，務求全方化了解摔角，投入摔角.

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 什麼表演能讓演員拿着劇本上台？今集主持訪問劇團的核心成員，聽聽這個劇團的發展，以及了解讀劇的形式.

programme.title: 平行教室
programme.desc: 執業全科牙醫 - Dr. Eric，提供專業口腔護理服務。他重視醫患溝通，細心地向客人講解，並透過社群媒體分享正確牙科知識，拉近大眾與專業醫療的距離.

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.desc: Shirley 作為促進亞洲的循環時尚的推動者，與團隊一同協助設計師並希望教育消費者，使循環時尚理念深入人心。每年舉辦活動收集公眾不再穿著的衣物，經由團隊進行篩選和整理。透過創新的「升級再造」設計，這些被回收的衣物能夠轉變為新穎的時裝單品，減少環境負擔，並實現資源的再利用。循環時尚是未來時尚產業的重要趨勢，透過他們的努力，推動社會對環保時尚的認知與重視.

programme.title: 台灣山步行
programme.desc: 位於台灣南投縣仁愛鄉的清境農場，海拔高達1700公尺，對台灣人來說，這裡也成為了夏天超知名的避暑勝地，有小瑞士稱號。而青青草原近年來最熱們的活動，就是這「牧羊人體驗」!!!戴上牛仔帽、穿上雨鞋，阿妹要化身一日羊褓姆，在這一大片草原裡，將上百隻的羊，全部趕到柵欄裡。騎馬逛清境你恐怕沒嘗過，在充滿異國風情的草原山坡裡，坐在馬背上前進，阿妹覺得自己好像變成皇室貴族了，最後，清境農場最知名的雲南擺夷菜上桌，歷史的因素，讓這邊充滿了許多滇緬料理，吃美食，聽歷史，真的很有趣.

programme.title: 終於飛到LA
programme.desc: 阿妹和 Jessica 來到洛杉磯的梅爾羅斯大街，有大學生最愛的打卡點和潮店，亦有可持續時裝店、二手服裝店，疫情後逛實體服裝店格外興奮，兩位主持還夢想成真，在街上偶遇荷里活電影明星！逛夠買夠，一於到訪由歷史建築改建而成美食廣場和聖塔莫尼卡的沙灘，好好吃一頓美食.

programme.title: Dr.Any毛
programme.sub-title: 貓奴長知識 貓瘟 vs 貓流感
programme.desc: 貓貓對身邊環境比較敏感，很少外出，但今集三位嘉賓竟然都能各自帶了自己的貓貓到場，一同認識貓瘟這個容易與貓流感混淆的疾病。這兩個病名稱容易混淆，但各自的成因、嚴重程度、治療方法卻大有不同!獸醫會即場為嘉賓的貓貓檢查身體，測試是否都是獸醫認證的健康主子.

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 牙齒健康與整體生活質素息息相關，但原來缺牙或牙周病絕非必然。本集邀請牙科醫生，剖析長者常見的口腔隱患，正確護齒技巧.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 《雙線運動人生》聚焦香港兼職運動員的故事。每集邀請一位從事普通職業、卻在閒暇投身運動的嘉賓，分享他們如何在繁忙的香港生活中平衡工作與熱情。他們用汗水與毅力詮釋「雙重身份」的精彩。節目呈現他們的起點、低谷與突破，探討時間管理、經濟壓力等挑戰，以及對夢想的執著。從日常訓練的堅持，到比賽中的難忘瞬間，觀眾將看到他們如何在快節奏的城市中為自己爭取一席之地.

programme.title: 舔舔脷·講講理
programme.desc: 牛奶在現今社會可以說是一個人類不可或缺的食材之一，奶製品和以牛奶作食材的食物更加是多不勝數。但是你知不知道牛奶來到香港後經歷過多少工序才送到我們手中呢？本集《舔舔脷．講講理》將會帶你拜訪牛奶製造廠，讓你了解一口美味的牛奶是如何煉成的.

programme.title: 學神出沒注意
programme.desc: 今集《學神出沒注意》終於輪到駕駛經驗超豐富的Sarika及旨呈挑戰學大巴！節目組當然安排了幾個考驗試試兩位高超身手！二人駕駛技術果然有料子，鬥快挑戰大帽山連續彎路、鬥快於極窄納米車位泊S位L位，二人毫不怯場，互不相讓！通過測試二人第一次上大巴，「老」司機頓變白紙！自認車神的旨呈不但流後更初嚐死火滋味；第一次揸棍波的Sarika尖叫聲不斷，更發生連環不幸死火事件！節目組也不禁為車上的師傅捏一把冷汗.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 幪面超人 ZEZTZ
聲的築城者
programme.desc: 《聲的築城者》是⼀個以香港為舞台的⽂化紀錄節⽬，透過鏡頭走訪⾳樂產業的不同⾓落，尋找那些推動香港⾳樂⽂化發展的靈魂⼈物。從舞台上光芒四射的歌⼿，到幕後默默耕耘的作曲家、填詞⼈、編曲⼈、監製，再到塑造市場與⾳樂⽅向的唱⽚公司，以及承載無數回憶的現場⾳樂表演場地──節⽬將全⾯呈現香港⾳樂⽣態背後的⼒量與故事.

programme.title: 夜漫遊
programme.desc: 初遊青島嘅Yoshi同Anton先到地標「五四廣場」打卡，喺凍到飛起嘅五月感受熱血又壯麗嘅「五月的風」，high起上嚟兩位仲化身光劍俠，無懼青島人眼光拎住細路玩具跳舞！其後Yoshi 帶Anton品嚐青島版嘅紅豆壽司，食到兩位紮紮跳，好彩同場有青島特色嘅人手造灌湯餃救返一命.

programme.title: 壯志凌雲
programme.desc: 「獨行俠」(湯姆·克魯斯 飾演)是一位桀傲不遜的年輕F-14戰機海軍飛行員，因為優秀的飛行技術與機緣而獲選加入美國海軍最頂尖的飛行訓練單位美國海軍戰鬥機武器學校（俗稱Top Gun）。在飛行學校中，獨行俠遇到該校的女教官Charlotte並與其發展出戀情。獨行俠在一次飛行訓練中，因為引擎捲入亂流熄火而墜機，導致搭檔的雷達攔截官野鵝在彈射逃生時意外喪生，因此陷入低潮。正當飛行學校的訓練結束，獨行俠一行人參加結訓典禮時，突然傳來上級的命令要求他們趕赴正在印度洋地區巡弋的企業號航空母艦報到，以馳援因為故障而受困在危險海域中的美方情報蒐集船。在戰鬥巡邏任務中，巡邏小隊突然遭到6架米格伏擊，而獨行俠則被安排在駕駛艙待命準備隨時出擊，在其中一架僚機被擊落後奉命緊急升空救援。原本獨行俠還困在喪友之痛中無心戰鬥，甚至一度脫離戰場而受到大夥們的責難，但最終他克服低潮重新振作，成功地擊退敵人，獲得全艦人員英雄式的迎接。事後，獨行俠選擇回到飛行學校任職教官，並與Charlotte重逢.

programme.title: 狗仔隊亂入Seoul
programme.desc: Dixon和Kathy拜訪犬界廣告寵兒松鼠狗CoCo公主之家，細聽KOL練成之路；CoCo公主及其親戚狗狗ANGE去品嚐寵物美食，展現驚人的吃播魅力；想打造公主般的衣櫃？CoCo帶大家去到韓國本地設計品牌時尚店瘋狂購物.

programme.title: 日本winwin企画
programme.desc: 今季Win Win與觀眾一齊做遊客，踏足從未到訪過的地點。第一站來到名古屋的Win Win，將會發掘近年日本新興的古著購物點，挑戰巨型麵食.

programme.title: 駐港家鄉味
programme.desc: 泰國是港人最愛旅遊地點之一，究竟這位溫文爾雅的泰國旅遊局香港辦事處處長Phornmon Chansri 女士，每年在香港會舉辦什麼樣的活動，從而每更加多人了解泰國呢？局長還會帶兩位主持去一間擁有傳統味道的泰國餐廳，有些美食還要是Off Menu，真是大開眼界.

programme.title: PJ Masks 超級聯盟
programme.sub-title: 星際仙子英雄 / 莉莉菲與湖泊

programme.title: 放學玩啲咩
programme.desc: 放學玩啲咩？顧名思義就是指放學後進行的各種學習與體驗，例如運動、藝術、才藝發展或個人興趣探索，朋友仔放學後希望到外面更專業的場地、跟更資深的導師學習，接觸校園裡沒有的器材與課程，真正專注磨練自己的興趣與專長，吸收更多元的知識、技能與人生經驗。其實香港好多同學都身懷絕技、他們之所以出色，正是因為願意利用放學後的時間，在外堅持練習、不斷進步，把興趣變成自己的優勢.

programme.title: 邁向新警界 III
programme.desc: 警隊設立十五個具特別功能的兼任職務隊，直擊危險地帶逆行者，實景模型了解案發過程， 鐵騎戰陣開路護送， 無人機隊守護社區安全， 「邁向新警界 III」 拆解警隊專業支援職務.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.

programme.title: 一路camp 一路遊
programme.desc: 搭乘纜車登上震撼的千疊敷冰斗，隨後在營地大快朵頤日本露營燒肉。隔天主持迎來終極挑戰——體驗滑翔傘翱翔天際！最後漫步駒草橋與充滿靈氣的光前寺，為這趟冒險留下精彩足跡.

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 亂吃東西、亂拔頭髮是何緣故？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來Kim一起請教醫生！究竟何謂異食癖和拔毛癖，有這個問題又怎麼辦.

programme.title: 啱Kee啱你多啲Keeta呈獻: 爆谷一周
programme.desc: 《爆谷一周》返嚟喇！作為全城最重磅影視娛樂訪談節目，今輯繼續為觀眾請來最新話題大作的焦點人物，盡訴幕後心中情，演員主創齊齊不設底線談天講地！除介紹令人翹首以待的首輪猛片，更有多集以香港影壇經典為主題，邀來各路影視英雄將影畫史娓娓道來，一同回顧經典，細述用無盡汗水鋪出的光影路！另設全新環節貼身追蹤電影生力軍嘅日常，了解他們不懈籌備新作的苦與樂！《爆谷一周》重裝上陣，共你一同穿梭香港電影的「現在」、「過去」與「未來」.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集邀請sica擔任嘉賓，以「大團圓結局」為主題，人生可能有不同的結果，但有「你」就是大團圓。此外，節目亦設有 「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事.

programme.title: 隊長小翼第二季 青少年篇
programme.desc: 決賽周第一場比賽，德國對烏拉圭，只有勝者能晉級下一輪。這場比賽由烏拉圭電光石火般的快攻展開序幕，開場僅50秒就由前鋒拉蒙維克多里諾爽快的魚躍補位射門破網。奪冠熱門德國竟然被先馳得點，令全場觀眾大為震驚。然而德國亦馬上憑施奈德的火焰射門追平。雙方陣營的前鋒對決，勝出的人是….

programme.title: 隊長小翼第二季 青少年篇
programme.desc: 決賽周第二場比賽，日本代表隊對上國際青少年大賽的主辦國法國，要在不斷歡呼的主場球迷包圍下作客比賽。小翼、岬、日向展開三階段攔截，從敵方主將皮埃爾腳下奪走皮球。全隊團結一致，緊密配合，令日本代表隊在本次大賽中第一次取得領先。皮埃爾看著1比0的計分板流露出悔恨的神情。「這樣的話，只能使出來了，我一直隱藏至今的射門…….

programme.title: 美麗40路
programme.desc: 誰說廣告市場只愛年輕女性？女人 40+ 同樣有吸引力！一眾 40 路接受客戶邀請，化身模特兒進行廣告硬照比賽！不過在巨蛇、蜘蛛及蜥蜴等阻礙下，一眾佳麗能完美達到客 戶要求，表現出該有的 40+ 魅力嗎？「美麗啟程」見證 Melody、Yolanda、Kiko、以嘉走過美麗大道.

programme.title: 貓之旅神
programme.desc: 《 貓之旅神》來到最後一集，當然要參觀土耳其著名的聖索菲亞清真寺，Shirley 及Asha為表誠意更特登挑選合適嘅頭巾！接住二人來到有頂大市集，更在大市集上蓋學特務電影007飛檐走壁？！驚慄刺激過後 ，二人就來到了有「最美好的村落」之稱的希林傑村 ，試咖啡占卜，嚐美酒，跟貓一同渡過最悠閒最寫意的旅程.

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥
programme.desc: 今集大玩個人賽，5位主持要憑他們的常識決一高下，有1位主持由頭帶到尾，敗績無人能敵，這位主角是否大家預期之中的那位？去到第2個遊戲，不用再只靠頭腦，完成到任務就有機會勝出，這位主持又能否在這個遊戲反敗為勝呢.

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.desc: Shirley 作為促進亞洲的循環時尚的推動者，與團隊一同協助設計師並希望教育消費者，使循環時尚理念深入人心。每年舉辦活動收集公眾不再穿著的衣物，經由團隊進行篩選和整理。透過創新的「升級再造」設計，這些被回收的衣物能夠轉變為新穎的時裝單品，減少環境負擔，並實現資源的再利用。循環時尚是未來時尚產業的重要趨勢，透過他們的努力，推動社會對環保時尚的認知與重視.

programme.title: 平行教室
programme.desc: 執業全科牙醫 - Dr. Eric，提供專業口腔護理服務。他重視醫患溝通，細心地向客人講解，並透過社群媒體分享正確牙科知識，拉近大眾與專業醫療的距離.

programme.title: 交易時段
programme.desc: 緊貼市場走勢，為你提供全面訊息，分析港股焦點新聞消息.

programme.title: 東京納米夢
programme.desc: Indi 8年前隻身上東京，千方百計要踏上東京劇社舞台，從低做起，台前幕後置景打雜乜都肯試肯做，終於得到一個自編自導劇作嘅機會！成功背後全賴媽媽無條件付出，當年知道女兒要去日本打拼，一炮過幫女兒喺中野置業，今集節目組更即席越洋連線，讓INDI可以當面感激媽媽全力支持.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB 推介

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: 設計新浪潮II
programme.desc: OFT Interiors 的設計師 CM 和 Ken曾負責多間電影院設計，除了實用和功能上的考量，他們亦相信一個好的室內設計能為顧客呈現一個故事，讓顧客留下深刻印象.

programme.title: 730 玩返轉
programme.sub-title: 上海薯仔主題餐廳｜熊本城職人小食街
programme.desc: 《730 玩返轉》CK走訪上海人氣薯仔主題餐廳，從薯仔造型菜式到店內裝潢充滿玩味，甚至猜想員工是否也化身薯仔形象。Jessica分享她在西班牙實習的寶貴經驗，以及多年獨自遊歷世界累積的智慧與感悟。Uppacase帶觀眾走進熊本城下的職人小食街，從燒烤到甜品，每道小食都承載著熊本的地方風味與職人堅持.

programme.title: 8點直樂 VIURIETY
programme.desc: 《8 點直樂 VIURIETY》為 1.5 小時綜藝節目，集娛樂、資訊、遊戲等不同元素於一身，送上多元而精彩的綜藝環節！星期一至五每晚都有獨特主題，包括 Food Night、The Choose Day、Men’s Challenge Night、Music Night 及 Play Hard Night。每一集主持、藝員及嘉賓傾力演出外，還有豐富獎金獎品送給全港觀眾，務求與大家共渡可能是最有玩味性的綜藝時光.

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 日落下的彩虹
programme.desc: Benson、Alice、家齊為錢撕破臉，互不妥協，堅持母親的家產應由自己取得！蘭姐夾在三子女之間，安慰自己「一家人嘈完就冇事」，但在最後一年的彩虹邨中秋節夜晚，卻等不到任何一個仔女回家，傷心不已。Alice要求兄弟兩人將多年來的家用錢全數歸還，令Benson陷財困，家齊更因此變回窮光蛋而被Caca狠飛！家齊深受打撃下大發酒瘋，掀起與Alice和Benson的肢體衝突！蘭姐突然收到影片，見到三個仔女用刀瘋狂互劈，血流披面，卻不知那是網民惡作劇的A.I.影片，嚇得她當場昏倒.

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 跳祭少女放飛假期
programme.desc: 全新戰場引爆！兩位少女轉戰石川縣，展開以「穿搭美學」為主題的修行！首站研究「浴衣人偶」的獨特美術風格，隨後更挑戰北陸最大的古著市場，落手落腳為店員拼湊出最時尚的潮流穿搭。緊接著，兩位少女漫步到充滿古風的茶屋街，探究如何將傳統工藝完美融入現代絲巾配搭之中。最後，她們率先殺入祭典地區的精緻 Cafe 試食限定甜品。由古著、絲巾到甜品美學，兩位少女能否在石川縣成功蛻變，參透專屬日本的極致美學.

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 日落下的彩虹
programme.desc: Windy與閨蜜們Sunnie和Moon，從小就有「一齊衝出彩虹邨」的約定。Sunnie在工廈租下Studio，一手包辦裝修，建立Dream House，以為從此就能跟好姊妹們黏在一起，卻沒料原來另外兩人心中隱約有其他打算──Windy想跟男友同居，Moon想慳錢出國遊學，只剩Sunnie一人為昔日約定而努力。Sunnie常常被放飛機，更發現Windy私自帶男友上Studio做「炮房」，友誼小船已面臨暗湧。終於因為Moon的一次不慎，把Studio弄成水浸災區，正式引爆各人早藏在心內的不滿！她們互相指責，愈說愈狠，最後斷言從此不見.

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 跳祭少女放飛假期
programme.desc: 石川縣修行第二彈！今集以「祭典的聲音」為核心，帶領兩位少女用聽覺與靈魂感受傳統的律動！她們正面迎擊兩大傳統技藝，一邊揮灑汗水學習節奏澎湃的「太鼓」，一邊要掌握氣勢磅礴的「獅子舞」。隨後兩人轉戰當地歷史悠久的民間爵士樂現場，沉浸在熱鬧的聲音之中，製作組竟無預警送上「終極神秘驚嚇環節」！嚇得平日最愛放飛自我的兩位跳祭少女靈魂出竅。由傳統巨響到恐懼的尖叫，這場高潮迭起的聲音考驗，她們到底能否順利過關.

programme.desc: 何惟芳急速返回家中，心中充滿希望。然而，劉申的人已先她一步到達何家，指責她頂撞婆母、逃家不侍夫君，卻未提及劉家對她的苛待與挪用嫁妝。何父誤以為是何惟芳逃家，答應與劉家一起尋人。何惟芳意識到自己已無家可歸，便騎馬來到懸崖邊，故意留下錢帛和一支步搖以擾亂追查。劉申的人看到步搖，認為何惟芳已墜崖身亡.

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.desc: Shirley 作為促進亞洲的循環時尚的推動者，與團隊一同協助設計師並希望教育消費者，使循環時尚理念深入人心。每年舉辦活動收集公眾不再穿著的衣物，經由團隊進行篩選和整理。透過創新的「升級再造」設計，這些被回收的衣物能夠轉變為新穎的時裝單品，減少環境負擔，並實現資源的再利用。循環時尚是未來時尚產業的重要趨勢，透過他們的努力，推動社會對環保時尚的認知與重視.

programme.title: 交易時段
programme.desc: 緊貼市場走勢，為你提供全面訊息，分析港股焦點新聞消息.

programme.title: ROVER 團魂修煉 第1集 -ROVER開展團魂修煉旅程 - 嘉賓: 強尼、Joey Tang
programme.desc: 樂隊ROVER正式出道，為打造大好前途，在香港、澳門及台灣接受為期近半年的修煉之旅；提升默契，培養團魂。但修煉還未展開，擔任隊長的Kim因未能協調隊友之間關係，令他壓力爆煲，不禁流下男下淚⋯⋯.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB 推介
programme.desc: 一首歌背後嘅故事、花咗好多心機嘅MV、歌手同幕後音樂人嘅心血… 《CHILL CLUB 推介》星期一至五晚一於全部都推介俾你.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: 給香港的情書 貳 第4集 -故事創作人 / 音樂人- 黃靖 Jing Wong
programme.desc: 黃靖（Jing Wong）是一位多才多藝的藝術家，兼任唱作歌手、舞台劇導演及時裝設計師，並深入研究桌遊與電子遊戲的敘事手法。他於倫敦中央聖馬丁藝術與設計學院取得舞台設計一級榮譽學位，隨後在中央語言及戲劇學院完成舞台導演碩士學位。黃靖的創作靈感源於「貪玩」，他深信遊戲與藝術的結合能豐富作品的表達。他在2018年舉辦了七場音樂獨腳戲，並擔任導師，培訓年輕音樂創作人才。近年，他更將目光投向桌遊領域，實驗性地融合遊戲與劇場形式，繼續追求他對夢想與遊戲的熱情.

programme.title: 730 玩返轉
programme.desc: 《730玩返轉》每晚為你帶來世界各地最新、最實用的旅遊情報，更有當地特色文化體驗、旅遊優惠資訊、以及旅遊達人的獨家分享。節目更與各地旅遊 KOL合作，希望為熱愛旅遊的香港人激發旅遊靈感，一起展開下一段未知的旅程啦.

programme.title: 背著善宰跑
programme.desc: 泰成妒忌與任率很親近的善宰。同時，泰成樂團的主音無法參加樂隊比賽，善宰為樂隊演唱。善宰將獎品作為禮物送給任率，但任率很不高興，因為她想阻止他在樂隊中唱歌的情況卻發生了.

programme.title: 史諾比開騷
programme.sub-title: 五星級小獵犬 / 史派克來訪 / 拒絕信之殤

programme.title: 無敵鹿戰隊 冰封計劃
programme.sub-title: 外星泡泡惹麻煩 / 音樂鬧劇

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 《雙線運動人生》聚焦香港兼職運動員的故事。每集邀請一位從事普通職業、卻在閒暇投身運動的嘉賓，分享他們如何在繁忙的香港生活中平衡工作與熱情。他們用汗水與毅力詮釋「雙重身份」的精彩。節目呈現他們的起點、低谷與突破，探討時間管理、經濟壓力等挑戰，以及對夢想的執著。從日常訓練的堅持，到比賽中的難忘瞬間，觀眾將看到他們如何在快節奏的城市中為自己爭取一席之地.

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 730 玩返轉
programme.desc: 《730玩返轉》每晚為你帶來世界各地最新、最實用的旅遊情報，更有當地特色文化體驗、旅遊優惠資訊、以及旅遊達人的獨家分享。節目更與各地旅遊 KOL合作，希望為熱愛旅遊的香港人激發旅遊靈感，一起展開下一段未知的旅程啦.

programme.title: 8點直樂 VIURIETY
programme.desc: 《8 點直樂 VIURIETY》為 1.5 小時綜藝節目，集娛樂、資訊、遊戲等不同元素於一身，送上多元而精彩的綜藝環節！星期一至五每晚都有獨特主題，包括 Food Night、The Choose Day、Men’s Challenge Night、Music Night 及 Play Hard Night。每一集主持、藝員及嘉賓傾力演出外，還有豐富獎金獎品送給全港觀眾，務求與大家共渡可能是最有玩味性的綜藝時光.

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 日落下的彩虹
programme.desc: 斌嫂自從離家後，重新學習一個人生活；斌哥則留守華麗理髮廳，思念斌嫂而不敢行動。但這時，卻突發出現一個震撼彈：原來Windy懷孕兼被渣男分手，傷心得醉倒街頭。斌哥斌嫂大為緊張，Windy卻死撐堅稱不需爸媽理會，反正二人離婚也同樣一意孤行，令一家人陷入僵局！另一邊廂，Sunnie 和 Moon得知消息後，毅然放下本身恩怨，去找Eddie晦氣，為姊妹出一口氣！Windy一直搖擺在生與不生之間，得到弟弟晨仔開解，才剛想嘗試做個好媽媽，卻在此時突然下體流血，痛得快要昏倒，她本能地按出了一個電話號碼求救….

programme.title: WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 跳祭少女放飛假期
programme.desc: 兩位少女要親眼見證上天賜予的天然禮物，如何透過一雙神之手化為傳奇。她們深入直擊石川傳統「漆器」的誕生過程。一塊平凡的木頭從樹木被砍伐開始，經歷無數道繁複而細緻的工序，最終才能演變成驚艷世人的精美漆器，徹底顛覆了她們對手工藝的想像！除了感官震撼，考驗隨即延伸至當地的日常生活。兩位少女要親自上陣，走入熱鬧的魚市場挑戰劏魚絕技，隨後更要落手落腳學習掘番薯。在這些看似平凡卻極講求手感的庶民日常中，她們能否極速開竅，領悟將自然食材與原料昇華的匠人靈魂.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 空肚講宵夜
programme.desc: Hailey畀綜藝之神眷顧，玩遊戲都可以玩到笑料百出。BabyJohn埋單計數計到開Excel ！？Hailey追飯錢手法層出不窮，旁敲側擊但求人哋主動畀錢.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: S Line
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在不久的將來，在這個世界中，人們過去的性關係通過一條發光的紅色「S線」在他們頭頂上方以視覺方式連接。一位刑警、一位神秘的老師，以及一個天生能看到這些線的少女，共同應對由這一現象引發的系列令人不安的事件.

programme.title: 榮耀：她們的法庭
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相.

programme.title: 鬼宮
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾.

programme.title: 協商的技術
programme.desc: 擁有一頭白色頭髮、不老容貌，被譽為傳奇談判專家的尹洙諾，開始了一場高風險的併購談判，拯救一度拋棄過他的公司 HM 集團。擁有精英團隊的專業人士－包括頂尖律師、會計師、行銷專家和專利專家律師的尹洙諾，利用自己無與倫比的技能去講述企業間併購的故事.

programme.title: 華麗的日子
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦.

programme.title: 亦舞之城
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難.

programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦.

programme.title: 亦舞之城
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難.

programme.title: 榮耀：她們的法庭
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相.

programme.title: 鬼宮
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾.

programme.desc: 擁有一頭白色頭髮、不老容貌，被譽為傳奇談判專家的尹洙諾，開始了一場高風險的併購談判，拯救一度拋棄過他的公司 HM 集團。擁有精英團隊的專業人士－包括頂尖律師、會計師、行銷專家和專利專家律師的尹洙諾，利用自己無與倫比的技能去講述企業間併購的故事.

programme.title: 華麗的日子
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦.

programme.title: 亦舞之城
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難.

programme.title: 榮耀：她們的法庭
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相.

programme.title: Professional 保險調查員・天音蓮
programme.desc: 前搜索一課精英刑警天音蓮，因未能阻止「保險金殺人案」引咎辭職，轉而加入保險調查公司「深山RESEARCH」。他與個性迥異的搭檔攜手，運用超凡洞察力與不拘一格的手段，深入調查各類離奇保險詐騙案件。在欺騙與真相、罪惡與救贖的邊界遊走，揭開隱藏在保單背後的陰謀與人性糾葛.

programme.title: 全領域異常解決室
programme.desc: 在最重視了解自然災害和吉凶的日本有著世界上最古老的調查機構「全領域異常解決辦公室」以解決難以想像的「無法解釋的異常案件」。但似乎隱藏著一個巨大的秘密. .....人們面對的「異常事件」，例如無法用科學解釋的超自然現象。這是一個可能真實發生在你身邊的故事。甚麼是真實的，甚麼是虛構的？ 真相在下一刻就變成了妄想.

programme.title: 波子汽水猴子
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅.

programme.title: 海的開始
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活.

programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅.

programme.title: 海的開始
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活.

programme.title: 華麗的日子
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦.

programme.title: 女神蒙上眼
programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事.

programme.title: 死亡之花
programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星.

programme.title: 鬼宮
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾.

programme.title: The Empire: 法之帝國
programme.desc: 講述的是夢想世襲的韓國最高法官貴族們的醜聞，以及人性與貪婪的故事。​.

programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事.

programme.title: 死亡之花
programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星.

programme.title: 鬼宮
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾.

programme.title: The Empire: 法之帝國
programme.desc: 講述的是夢想世襲的韓國最高法官貴族們的醜聞，以及人性與貪婪的故事。​.

programme.title: 愛情而已
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情.

programme.title: 虎鶴妖師錄
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事.

programme.title: 剝繭
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事.

programme.title: 愛情而已

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人.

programme.title: 虎鶴妖師錄
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事.

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人.

programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情.

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人.

programme.title: 虎鶴妖師錄
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事.

programme.title: 夜色正濃
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去.

programme.title: 夜色正濃

programme.title: 誰是兇手
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁.

programme.title: 天啟異聞錄
programme.desc: 《天啟異聞錄》講述了天啟年間，一場神秘疫病爆發，錦衣衛褚思鏡（黃軒飾）在孤島存亡危機中歷險破局的故事。 天啟年間，遼東關外怪病肆虐，人心惶惶，一錦衣衛隻身北上探查，不料卻卷入當地軍民鬥爭，在終日籠罩遼東的迷霧之後，武術詭譎陰謀也正潛滋暗長，無形的觸手正伺機而動….

programme.title: 夜色正濃
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去.

programme.title: 虎鶴妖師錄

programme.title: 誰是兇手
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁.

programme.title: 愛情而已
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情.

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人.

programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事.

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人.

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人.

programme.title: 地球超新鮮
programme.desc: 由劉宇寧、龔俊、孫紅雷、李乃文、陳赫、陳星旭、王玉雯、歐陽娣娣組成爆笑「地球團」，沿著地球脈絡從中國出發，感受北緯40度的煙火氣，通過遊戲任務解鎖各地文化與美食，用新鮮有趣的方式，探索全世界的同頻快樂.

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.sub-title: 潘瑋柏獻上此生最高評價
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.

programme.title: 超腦少年團
programme.desc: 邀請了馬清運、伊能靜、楊芸晴等嘉賓擔任「超腦護航員」；節目根據“八大未來力”的概念來進行項目設置，少年們需要用創造性思維激發想像力，利用從紙筆到程式設計來破解難題，從而喚醒大腦活力，選拔出最具“未來力”的少年.

programme.title: 與君渡長歡
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生.

programme.title: 夙夜集
programme.desc: 蒼梧國大將軍之女羲和遭滅門及暗算，重生為廢柴嫡女沈千夜。她懷著滿腔不甘踏上復仇之路，與疑似凶手的「小皇叔」裴夙糾纏不休。在調查真相的過程中，兩人從相互算計到聯手抗敵，揭開了蒼梧國隱藏的重重秘密.

programme.title: 有朋自遠方來 第2季
programme.desc: 以文化交流為創作核心理念，由外籍年輕人組成貴州體驗團，以民宿為切口，打卡推薦貴州的吃、住、行、遊、購、娛，體驗不一樣的貴州生活，開啟中外青年的貴州探索之旅.

programme.title: 有朋自遠方來 第3季
programme.desc: 國際攝影師和國內「Z世代」青年將結伴旅拍貴州，行走5條貴州特色文旅路線，這一次他們將有怎樣的奇遇呢.

programme.title: 味道 第四季
programme.desc: 以美食為介質的全新文化訪談類節目，每集邀請文化名人、名廚大師、外籍帥哥、直播網紅和民間饕客一同做客飯局，在品嚐民間美味的同時，分享人生故事.

programme.title: 音你而來 第3季
programme.sub-title: 劉雨昕容祖兒破防喊冤笑翻全場
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅.

programme.title: 超燃青春的合唱
programme.sub-title: 希林娜依高段奧娟國風戲腔
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程.

programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 偏愛島首輪離島誰去誰留
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.

programme.title: 與君渡長歡
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生.

programme.title: 黑月光法則
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則.

programme.title: 姐姐當家
programme.sub-title: 謝娜母女唱雙簧哄爸爸
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣.

programme.title: 快樂趣吹風
programme.sub-title: 大張偉地獄級難度猜歌力挽狂瀾
programme.desc: 由秦昊、大張偉、高瀚宇、顏人中、徐志勝、田嘉瑞組成「高能抽風團」，他們將與好友奔赴海南入住吹風小屋，以「減法生活」開啟一段旅行體驗；通過任務挑戰與即興遊戲贏取生活物資，徹底拋開偶像包袱，呈現最真實的互動與眾多「抽風」瞬間.

programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 超燃青春的合唱
programme.sub-title: 希林娜依高段奧娟國風戲腔
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手.

programme.title: 非來不可 第3季
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程.

programme.title: 火星情報局 第7季
programme.sub-title: 薛之謙楊迪眾籌黃子上火星

programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅.

programme.title: 說唱夢工廠
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星.

programme.title: 味道 第四季
programme.desc: 以美食為介質的全新文化訪談類節目，每集邀請文化名人、名廚大師、外籍帥哥、直播網紅和民間饕客一同做客飯局，在品嚐民間美味的同時，分享人生故事.

programme.title: 地球超新鮮
programme.desc: 由劉宇寧、龔俊、孫紅雷、李乃文、陳赫、陳星旭、王玉雯、歐陽娣娣組成爆笑「地球團」，沿著地球脈絡從中國出發，感受北緯40度的煙火氣，通過遊戲任務解鎖各地文化與美食，用新鮮有趣的方式，探索全世界的同頻快樂.

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.

programme.title: 超腦少年團
programme.desc: 邀請了馬清運、伊能靜、楊芸晴等嘉賓擔任「超腦護航員」；節目根據“八大未來力”的概念來進行項目設置，少年們需要用創造性思維激發想像力，利用從紙筆到程式設計來破解難題，從而喚醒大腦活力，選拔出最具“未來力”的少年.

programme.title: 與君渡長歡
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生.

programme.title: 黑月光法則
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則.

programme.title: 有朋自遠方來 第3季
programme.desc: 國際攝影師和國內「Z世代」青年將結伴旅拍貴州，行走5條貴州特色文旅路線，這一次他們將有怎樣的奇遇呢.

programme.sub-title: 全員絞盡腦汁尋找超合拍搭檔

programme.desc: Elmer Bernstein's score highlights this story of two women who arrive in 1920s New York searching for work and romance.

programme.title: 魔戰王：貝奧武夫
programme.desc: Beowulf, a Scandinavian hero, battles the monstrous Grendel to save the Danes in this epic adaptation of the classic Old English poem.

programme.title: 別叫我“賭神
programme.desc: Water Ng, a typical loser who likes to gamble and takes no responsibility is asked to take care of his ex-girlfriend Jik's son, Yeung. With Jik tells him that Yeung is his son, and promised 100 thousand dollars, Water Ng agrees to be a father for one month. Soon he notices his son has Autism. He gets to understand the difficulties of raising a child along with special needs. With Jik's absence on the agreed date, Water Ng realizes why she brought him his blood. He finds his life goal while discovering Yeung's talent on the racing field, then decides to get rid of the dissipated life and accompany his son spreading wings for the dream.

programme.title: 片場職人 -霍佩詩
programme.desc: Ceci Fok, the art director of the film “Night King”, unveils how Hong Kong filmmakers create boundless imagination with limited resources, deeply deconstructing how to construct unique visual aesthetics in different film genres, the process of collecting props for the film, and how tedious work is transformed into endless fun, silently building passionate artistic dream brick by brick behind the scene.

programme.title: 沉默的證人
programme.desc: A cat-and-mouse game unfolds over a single night when three armed criminals barge into a morgue, demanding the forensic doctor and his assistant to hand over a bullet lodged inside a corpse. While the criminals are in a desperate attempt to hide their true identities, the doctor finds himself sinking deeper and deeper into a quagmire as his past inadvertently catches up with him. Each explosive twist soon pushes the characters beyond their limits.

programme.title: 24小時救參行動
programme.desc: A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. The Korean government dispatches Jae-ho, known as one of Korea's most skilled diplomats, in order to handle the situation. Once he arrives, he asks for the Afghan government's cooperation and uses every means possible to free the hostages. However, his efforts go in vain. Due to his failure, he's forced to work with Dae-sik, a special agent who is an expert on the Middle East. As they begin making their move to get to the Taliban, the first hostage death occurs. With nowhere else to turn, the two become unlikely allies in a race against time to save the rest of the hostages.

programme.title: 終極無間
programme.desc: Ten months after the murder of Yan (Tony Leung), Ming (Andy Lau) is relegated to the backseat of mundane office work, pending internal investigation. Exhausted mentally and physically, Ming is running on empty, but he is convinced that he can reverse his fortune in no time. Meanwhile, a new star has emerged in the police force. Hardly forty years old, Wing (Leon Lai) has already risen to the top echelon thanks to his illustrious track record..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -開箱未來
programme.desc: KOREEDA Hirokazu, the acclaimed Japanese director and Palme d'Or winner, has reunited with AYASE Haruka after a decade for the film “Sheep in the Box”, in which he deliberately paired her with the comedian Daigo (CHIDORI) and such 'Beauty and the Beast' dynamic sparked real chemistry on camera despite the seemingly jarring contrast between the two. Since he has woven a heart-stirring story of family bonds using AI technology and been full of praise for the child actor KUWAKI Rimu in this film, what exactly drove him to focus his lens on children.

programme.title: 超能神探
programme.desc: One day, Hyun-joon, a policeman who lives with his mother and his daughter, attains a superpower after getting struck by the lightning. After the incident, Hyun-joon realizes that there are others who have been going through the same situation with him, and gets involved with unexpected situations. Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal.

programme.title: 奪命金
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles.

programme.title: 王的盛宴
programme.desc: The early history of a nation unfolds through the actions of three heroes – Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Han Xin – who chased their dreams of uniting a warring nation and fought through major milestones of the Chu-Han Contention years in the third century. From the Julu War to the Hongmen Banquet, the Gaixia War to the death of HanXin, the narration of Liu Bang – who would be the founding emperor of the new Han Dynasty – sets the stage for a tale of betrayal and brothers at war, where the last man standing inherits a nation.

programme.title: 重生
programme.desc: In a secluded corner of Mancheng City, a ruthless drug trafficking group stops at nothing to achieve their goals, leading to countless individuals falling into the abyss of shattered families due to drug addiction. Zhang Yao, who has been persecuted by drug traffickers to the point of losing everything, seeks revenge. He secretly collaborates with Captain An Du of the anti-drug squad to set up a ruthless trap to eliminate the top bosses of the criminal syndicate. However, behind this plan lies a carefully orchestrated game of revenge. Do they have the same enemy or do they each have their own hidden agendas? In this showdown, who is truly in control, and who is merely a pawn being manipulated? As the crisis looms, will they sink or awaken to reality? Proceed with caution as everything unfolds..

programme.title: 一個人的武林
programme.desc: A vicious killer Feng is going round Hong Kong killing top martial arts exponents, leaving a secret weapon called the Moonshadow as his calling card. When convicted killer and kung fu expert, Xia, hears of this, he offers to help the police catch the killer, in return for his freedom. Despite their misgivings, the police release the former police martial arts instructor into their custody. With his help, they realize from the chronological order of the victims that the killer is targeting his victims, all the top masters in their martial arts style, following a martial code of training. When Xia also disappears after a close encounter with Feng, they suspect the worse..

programme.title: 漫畫殺人狂
programme.desc: Reality and fiction clash in demented ways in this serial killer thriller by award-winning advertisement director Akira Nagai. Reuniting with Nagai after his maniacally fun performance in Teiichi: Battle of Supreme High, Japanese cinema's “It Boy”, Masaki Suda, reveals his dark side as Keigo, a talented illustrator who is way too nice to write a villain in his comics. After witnessing the death of a family at the hands of a terrifying murderer, Keigo draws the murderer into his comic 34 and ends up creating a runaway hit. Co-starring Shun Oguri as a police detective chasing the serial killer, Character is a hair-raising chiller packed with unpredictable twists.

programme.title: 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold..

credits.director: 徐克, 林嶺東, 杜琪峯

programme.title: 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks..

programme.title: 忘不了
programme.desc: Siu Wai is widowed when her husband was killed in accident. She becomes a mini-bus driver for her living and gradually finds comfort in Dai Fai. As Dai Fai falls for Siu Wai..

programme.title: 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost.

programme.title: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -哪吒2「聲」級三人組
programme.desc: Fish Liew, Jennifer Yu and Peter Chan Charm Man, have been invited to voice over Cantonese version of the animation film “Ne Zha 2”. This episode features these three actors sharing the joys and challenges of the dubbing process. While Fish tells that Cantonese has been a big challenge for her, Jennifer surprisingly wants to gigantify herself when asked which character's magic she would like to acquire and Peter also praises Fish even more! Let's find more fascinating behind-the-scenes stories they are going to share one by one.....

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童鬧海（粵語配音版
programme.desc: Ne Zha returns again joining by versatile stars - Jennifer Yu, Fish Liew and Peter Chan, who bring their unique voices and witty dialogue to the adventures of Ne Zha and Ao Bing and breathe a new life into the story. After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. Together, they embark on a new journey to challenge their fate.

programme.title: 你咪理，我愛你
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: 戀愛病毒
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -怒火交鋒
programme.desc: “The Furious” Director Kenji Tanigaki, Producer Frank Hui and leading actor Xie Miao are invited to share their filming experiences. Frank reveals the best fighter agreed unanimously upon by five martial arts masters in the film. Xie talks about how he used punches to express the character's ruthlessness! Kenji also unveils the hardships behind creating one of the major scenes with 'five-person melee battle' in the film.

programme.title: 大約在冬季
programme.desc: In front of the venue of CHYI Chin's concert, An tries to get herself a concert ticket while the tickets are sold out. Looking at the frustrated girl, Xiao walks towards the girl and gives her free tickets. It was 1991. After two years, An meets Xiao again. They fall in love with each other. The distance between Taipei and Beijing doesn't stop the lovers. However, under the pressure of Xiao's family, the lovers are separated. Xiao is forced to marry another woman..

programme.title: 葉問4完結篇
programme.desc: Ip Man's life remains unchanged after his wife's death, but he and his son are slowly drifting apart. To seek a better future for his son, Ip Man decides to travel to the U.S. only to find the stable, peaceful life abroad is only skin deep. Underneath lies a deep rooted racial discrimination that is far worse than he has expected. Ip Man re-examines his position and ponders on the reason he took up martial arts in the beginning.

programme.title: 恐怖在線
programme.desc: In 2003, a collision between a double-decker bus and a truck in Tuen Mun took the lives of 21 people. Ten years after the accident, several tenants on the Yau Oi Estate, which is located near the scene of the collision, report witnessing a woman clad in red jumping to her death on multiple nights, prompting veteran police officer Gu to go investigate with rookie cop Bee At the same time, radio DJ Poon Siu Chung returns to the site of the Tuen Mun collision with a group of students hoping to investigate the circumstances of the crash. When strange things start happening to the students, Gu and Bee are called to help. The two seemingly unconnected investigations converge as Gu realizes the incidents are connected.

programme.title: 失眠
programme.desc: During Japan's wartime occupation of Hong Kong in 1941-1945, a young translator's collaboration with the enemy results in his life being cursed by a murdered 'comfort woman' forced to become a sex slave. Forty-five years later, the man's sins come back to haunt his son, a professor specializing in sleeping disorders, when the lady's ghost returns for vengeance.

programme.title: 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: The most glamorous part of Seoul, Apgujeong thrives with new possibilities. Dae-guk who is a native of Apgujeong and rules its ground, is eager to start his own groundbreaking plastic surgery business. Then he encounters Ji-woo, the most talented surgeon in the area who lost his medical license due to someone sabotaging his reputation. Dae-guk effortlessly comes up with an idea to make this business happen, and he does everything he can to make Ji-woo his partner. Together, Dae-guk and Ji-woo open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..

programme.title: 樣衰衰奇兵
programme.desc: From the filmmakers of Shrek and Alita: Battle Angel comes a new animated musical adventure. In the adorably different town of Uglyville, the free-spirited Moxy and her UglyDolls friends confront what it means to be different, struggle with their desire to be loved, and ultimately discover that you don't have to be perfect to be amazing because who you truly are is what matters most.

programme.title: 我的幸福婚約
programme.desc: In a fictional Japan of Meiji Era, a time of remarkable civilization and enlightenment, people from families that have inherited special abilities [inou] have been protecting people from various disasters together with the emperor who rules the country. Miyo Saimori was from one of the prestigious families but born without the ability, and has lived her whole life being abused by her stepmother and half-sister. She is ordered to marry a ruthless soldier, Kiyoka Kudo, who leads the Alien Force at a young age, as a political ploy. True to the rumors that numerous potential fiancees had fled within three days, Kiyoka coldly told Miyo, 'You must obey me here. If I tell you to leave, leave. If I tell you to die, you die.” Miyo, who has no place to run away to, realizes during her stay at the Kudo household that Kiyoka is not the man he is reputed to be. Kiyoka is also touched by Miyo's thoughtfulness, and the two eventually establishes a special bond with each other. A light shine.

programme.title: 紅毯先生
programme.desc: The Hong Kong movie star Lau Wai-chi misses out again on the Hong Kong film awards. He sits in his office, making short videos that pay tribute to the characters he has played over his forty-year career. But trying to regain popularity this way feels desperate and cheap. He needs to make a film again. He contacts Chinese director Lin Hao, as he wants to star in a film shot in the countryside, playing an ordinary farmer, something he has never done before. This film he thinks will help restore his career to glory. Yet he is so used to being a movie star and having a special treatment in his everyday life, that it is hard for him to connect with the people of the street or peasants, people who have a lower social status than him. Even with women, there seems to exist an impassable barrier. For his new role to be successful, he needs to learn from the villagers how they really live and speak. But they see through his arrogance and vanity – as does the crew. The big star is nobod.

programme.title: 脫單香氣神助攻
programme.desc: Chang-soo, a guy who has never been in a romantic relationship, earns a magical power after accidentally wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger. The supernatural power he earns is what any man would dream of, an ability to attract every woman in the world! Ara, a woman Chang-soo has been in love with, begins to sense the scent of Chang-soo and falls in love with him. While they gradually grow their connection, Ara's ex-boyfriend, James, suddenly appears and reveals Chang-soo's secret! Will the two people overcome this predicament and find true love in each other.

programme.title: 精武家庭
programme.desc: A mysterious person arrived in his wheelchair in Yue's Clinic and asked for a person called Tai Chi Lung. Later on, Yue was found disappeared, leaving behind his clinic a mess..

programme.title: 飛翔吧﹗埼玉2
programme.desc: A live-action film adaptation of Mineo Maya's “Fly Me to the Saitama” turned out to be a huge, unexpected box office hit of 2019. With the producers who took the demand for a sequel as real, the cast and crew got back together to complete the second chapter of the urban legend in Fly Me To The Saitama -FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE-. In addition to the biting yet affectionate dissing of Saitama and the Kanto region in the first film, the sequel contains an even more scathing dissing of the Kansai region. Alongside costars GACKT and Fumi Nikaido, Ryo Kato and Tsubasa Masuwaka reprise their roles as members of the Saitama Liberation Front. A crucial protagonist who joins their battle, Kai Kikyo, the handsome leader of the Shiga Liberation Front, is played by Anne in her first role as male character. Akira Kashoji, the ruthless governor of Osaka and kingpin of the Kansai region who stands in the way of Rei and others, is played by Ainosuke Kataoka. In addition to Norika Fujiwara and.

programme.title: 我愛HK開心萬歲
programme.desc: Ng Shun returns with his wife Shun-Soh and three children to celebrate Ng Kin's 60th birthday. Unknown to Kin, his son has gotten into trouble and is plotting for him to take the rap. At the same time, Long, a swindler who conned money from the neighbours 30 years ago is now a property tycoon. He promises to pay each of the 30 neighbours HK$100 million as compensation as long as a representative of each household returns to the estate on Lunar New Year's Eve. A mad rush ensues as Shun and his family tries to gather the old neighbours to avoiding missing the bonanza.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 選擇有罪
programme.desc: You Man-su, a specialist in paper manufacturing with 25 years of experience, is so satisfied with life that he can truthfully tell himself, “I've got it all.” While happily passing his days with his wife Miri, their two children and two dogs, Man-su is suddenly informed by his company that he has been fired. “We're sorry. We have no other choice.” Feeling shocked as if his head had been cut off by an ax, Man-su vows to find himself a new job within the next three months for the sake of his family. Despite his firm resolve to turn his life around, Man-su spends over a year drifting from one job interview after another, and working at a retail store. He eventually finds himself in danger of losing the very house that he struggled so hard to buy. Desperate, he visits Moon Paper out of the blue and tries to hand over his CV, but he just ends up getting humiliated by line manager Choi Sun-chul. Man-su knows he is better qualified than anyone to work at Moon Paper, so he comes to a.

programme.title: 出埃及記
programme.desc: Tsim Kin Yip has been an ordinary beat cop for more than two decades, failing all the promotion interviews he's tried over the years. One afternoon, Tsim is on duty in the report room. Kwan Ping Man, a suspect accused of peeping in a women's washroom, is giving a statement. Tsim heard the big secret from Kwan there's a global women's organization plotting to kill all the men in the world. Tsim finds the story ridiculous but no choice but to write down what he's told. That night, Kwan's statement has gone missing. He returns to the station to take another report, but this time Kwan has switched his story and pleads guilty. It seems he has something to hide. Tsim's suspicions are aroused and he decides to do some investigating..

programme.title: 我們的十八歲
programme.desc: This is a story about how family can impact the growth of a young woman. It follows Elaine, who grew up in poverty in the 1980's, and her best friend Ying as they enter the Hong Kong entertainment industry to change their fate. In the golden era of Hong Kong cinema, Ying becomes a popular erotic star while Elaine struggles between her identity and her job as an actor. When Hong Kong cinema's glory fades a decade later, the two women end up on diverging paths due to their life choices.

programme.title: 公寓裡的兩個女人
programme.desc: Yi-jung lives with her mother Su-kyung, but they do not get along well with each other. While out grocery shopping one day, they fight as usual and Su-kyung's car ends up hitting Yi-jung in the parking lot. Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime and establish a new China. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang..

programme.title: 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight..

programme.title: 水餃皇后
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang Jianhe, a woman from Qingdao, was forced to leave her hometown with her two daughters. To make ends meet and raise her children, she washed dishes by day and cleaned cars by night. With no one to rely on, she bore the immense pressure alone. Determined to break free from her fate, Zang Jianhe decided to make a living by selling dumplings. From struggling to attract customers to eventually thriving, she received much support from tough-but-kind Hong Jie, Brother Hua, and Uncle Dessert. Through perseverance, she grew her dumpling business into a success, and her life gradually opened up to new possibilities... The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: 一念無明
programme.desc: The film begins with an old man who has long been absent as a father, picking up his son, who is suffering from bipolar disorder, from a mental hospital. Both men are in deep remorse for the accident that caused the death of the mother. The tension and anxiety boil as they stay with each other in a tiny subdivided flat. As time passes, they realize the pain between one another is not the only confrontation that awaits them; but to face the cruel world that they are living in.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：鄭秀文: 衝上雲霄
programme.desc: Young pilot Branson recently takes over Skylette, his father's aviation empire, only to realize his old flames Cassie is a flight attendant there. Several years ago, he was forced to break up with her and move to New York to take care of his father's business. To this day, the two continue to harbor feelings for each other but decide to keep them bottled up. In an effort to rebrand the airline, Branson invites rock idol TM to star in an upcoming commercial and appoints Sam as her flying consultant. Incongruent in both tastes and experience, this odd couple gets off on the wrong foot. As the shoot progresses, however, they slowly discover each other's merits, developing a strong mutual attraction. Jayden has left Skylette Airline to become a pilot for private jets. He meets the young and vivacious Kika during a flight and assumes her to be wayward and shallow. But they turn out to have a lot in common and start falling madly in love. At the height of their romance, Jayden real.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 新．超人
programme.desc: The continued appearance of giant unidentified life forms known as “S-Class Species (Kaiju)” has become commonplace in Japan. Conventional weapons have no effect on them. Having exhausted all other options, the Japanese Government issued the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol and formed an enforcement unit, known as the SSSP. The members chosen for the unit are: captain Kimio Tamura, strategic planner Shinji Kaminaga, unparticle physicist Akihisa Taki, and biologist Yumi Funaberi. In the midst of a Kaiju threat, a silver giant appears from beyond Earth's atmosphere. Analyst Hiroko Asami is newly appointed to the SSSP to deal with this giant and is partnered with Shinji Kaminaga. In Hiroko's report, she writes-“Ultraman, identity unknown.

programme.title: 桃姐
programme.desc: Ms. Zhong Chun-tao had served the Leung's family as a domestic helper since the age of 13. Time went fast and the past sixty years flew by. During this time, some members of the Leung's family had passed away, whilst the rest had emigrated and left the country for good. For the past decade, sister Tao and the only successor of the family, Roger, were the sole remaining members. The master-servant relationship between the two was well and supportive through mutual understanding, but lack of proper communication. One day thereafter, sister Tao was found suffering from..

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播: 夜校女生
programme.desc: Set in 1997's Banqiao, Taiwan, the story explores the struggles and brilliance of a girl named Xiao Ai as she navigates her journey of growth. Originally accepted into her dream high school, Xiao Ai is compelled by her mother to transfer to the night school at Taipei First Girls' High School. Sharing desks with day students during the day, she forms a deep friendship with her 'desk mate,' Min Min. However, feeling inferior because of her identity as a night school student, she and Min Min both develop feelings for the gifted student, Luke. To conceal the truth, she dons the day school uniform and pretends to be the 'perfect girl' who matches Luke. The green uniform gives her confidence, but it also causes her lies to spiral out of control. On the day of the joint entrance exam, the truth is revealed, and Xiao Ai faces a heart-wrenching trial of growth amidst the storms of friendship, love, and family..

programme.title: 才貌「謙」備: 潛行
programme.desc: In the new century, the fight against drugs faces an unprecedented and difficult challenge! Under the deep and complex dark network, an invisible war is being waged in Hong Kong...... Typhoon signal was hoisted in Hong Kong. Under the cover of the fierce wind, four tons of methamphetamine were entering Hong Kong, pending to be sold on the dark network. A cyber revelry of druggies was about to be unveiled, and a storm was brewing in the quiet Victoria Harbour. Police had to arrest the “boss” behind the scenes and nip the “drug network” in the bud in no time, that pushed their undercover intelligence to the narrow road. In the center of the storm, undercover agents, police officers, drug lords, black, white, and gray entangled.

programme.title: Laughing Gor之潛罪犯
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: 頭文字Ｄ
programme.desc: Takumi delivers tofu in father's old Toyota every day and unwittingly acquires difting skills. An unexpected victory awakens his competitive genes, leading him to fierce races.

programme.title: 大追捕
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong celebrity is found brutally murdered, detective Lam is called in to take charge. But the more that Lam pursues his suspect, the deeper he falls into a web of lies.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 武俠
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi lives a seemingly normal life in a remote village. But his peaceful life is soon to be disrupted when a determined detective digs up his past.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -開箱未來
programme.desc: KOREEDA Hirokazu, the acclaimed Japanese director and Palme d'Or winner, has reunited with AYASE Haruka after a decade for the film “Sheep in the Box”, in which he deliberately paired her with the comedian Daigo (CHIDORI) and such 'Beauty and the Beast' dynamic sparked real chemistry on camera despite the seemingly jarring contrast between the two. Since he has woven a heart-stirring story of family bonds using AI technology and been full of praise for the child actor KUWAKI Rimu in this film, what exactly drove him to focus his lens on children.

programme.title: 信用欺詐師JP：英雄篇
programme.desc: The “Third Generation Tsuchinoko” -- the master con man hailed as a “hero” has died. Dako, Boku-chan and Richard all honed their skills under his tutelage. The title of 'Tsuchinoko' is handed down in secrecy to the Confidence Man (scammer) with the greatest skill, setting the stage for a showdown between his three star pupils. The contest will take place in the world heritage city of Valletta, Malta, an international gathering place for the rich and famous.Their target is the invaluable ancient Greek sculpture “Dancing Venus”, currently owned by a wealthy, retired Spanish gangster. Each scammer adopts a unique strategy in pursuit of the target, but the police and Interpol are also hot on their heels. Who will laugh last?! No one knows how the biggest scam in history will end! Who is the true 'hero' and what is the ultimate 'truth'? The last con game, grand finale, Battle Royale...begins now.

programme.title: 傷城
programme.desc: In a city of love and prosperity, a city of lost hope and premature death, veteran detective Hei feels it all: the hurt, the helplessness, the horror. When his father-in-law, the billionaire benefactor Chau, is gruesomely murdered in his palatial mansion, he enlists the assistance of his former partner turned private detective, Bong.

programme.title: 戀愛大都會
programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -UFO命案大揭秘
programme.desc: Filmed in just eleven days, the low-budget production “Unidentified Murder” saw a massive burst of creativity from both the cast and crew; the actors' improvisations kept the set filled with laughter. In this Interview, the creative team is invited to share their production process and reveal the chaotic, unpredictable moments the crew experienced while filming up on the hill.

programme.title: 他年她日
programme.desc: Measure in Love is set in the universe where a massive earthquake has divided the world into Aurora Zone and Evergreen Zone, and the “Wall of Gravity” standing in the middle of the sea distorts time and gravity differently on both sides. One day in Aurora Zone equals one year in Evergreen Zone. When Ann-Jean from the Aurora Zone meets Tato from the Evergreen Zone, can their love break through the irresistible fate of time differences.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：我們的恐龍日記
programme.desc: Shinchan is really excited about the coming summer holiday! What's amazing about this summer is that there is a special news that shocks the whole world - A “Dinosaur Park” that revives extinct dinosaurs is opened in Tokyo! What's more, the Kasukabe Team receives a special invitation to explore the new park! The team enjoys the facilities in the world-renowned “Dinosaur Park” while having a close look on giant dinosaurs, and become so excited about everything they see! After opening of the park, a dinosaur fever is all the rage worldwide! At the same time, Shiro meets a little dinosaur called “Nana” at the riverside. As Shinchan and his friends beg sincerely, Nana becomes a member of the Nohara family, living together with Shinchan and Shiro, and creates a lot of wonderful memories. However, when Shinchan is enjoying this unique summer, dinosaurs suddenly escape from the park and rush into Tokyo! How will this “Dinosaur Crisis” end? What is the secret behind Nana's appearance.

programme.title: 女兒的女兒
programme.desc: Now a widow in her sixties, Aixia must become a mother once more when she receives custody of her daughter's daughter – in the form of a fertilized embryo left by Aixia's daughter Zuer, who tragically died in a car accident. However, Aixia already has a second daughter: Emma, who Aixia abandoned as a teenager, and the shame over abandoning Emma has never faded.

programme.title: 捕風追影
programme.desc: A crew of criminal prodigies disappears with billions, evading capture by outsmarting the formidable “Sky Eye” surveillance system. Desperate and outmaneuvered, the Macau police enlist the help of a legend-Wong Tak-Chung, a retired tracking expert. He mentors rookie officer He Qiuguo and rebuilds an elite surveillance unit. Their mission: to track down the elusive “Wolf King,” Fu Longsheng, the mastermind behind the heist. As the police close in, the thieves spring a trap of their own. Brains clash, loyalties are tested, and the ultimate cat-and-mouse game is about to begin..

programme.title: 放‧逐
programme.desc: Two hit men from Hong Kong sent to take out a renegade member trying to turn over a new leaf with his wife and newborn baby. They soon find themselves in the throes of a dilemma when two of their former associates also show up, intent on thwarting them at every cost..

programme.title: 爆谷影之選 微電影「創+作」（音樂篇）
programme.desc: A half-baked psychic partners with his younger brother to make a living through scams, but they find themselves in trouble when they take on a commission to locate a family's secret Chinese barbecue recipe. As he gradually grows closer to the client who has lost his father, the psychic ritual-originally intended as a con-unexpectedly uncovers the unspoken truths from both families.

programme.title: 七月返歸
programme.desc: Heung Wing has been sensitive to paranormal activity and keeps seeing ghosts since he was a kid, which is called having “Yin Yang” eyes. To avoid being excluded by his peer, he was taught to pretend nothing happened, even though he knew their existence. He then left from Hong Kong to Canada because of his miserable childhood. One day, Heung Wing is told that his mother has been in coma by committing suicide, which forces him to return to Hong Kong. When he goes back to the old home, everything looks strange and unfamiliar to him. What's more horrifying is, a series of weird cases happen in the neighbourhood, and ghosts show up in front of him again. The situation is deteriorating beyond his imagination..

programme.title: 12金鴨
programme.desc: Devastated by a love affair, former in-demand gigolo Future Chang retreats to Thailand. Thanks to the intervention of his high school teacher, Future summons the courage to return..

programme.title: 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize.

programme.title: 絕世好B
programme.desc: Lena, Johnny and Wayne are commissioned to expand a new line of business specializing in merchandise for infants named 'Mighty Baby'. Johnny, enjoying his new perks as a supervising executive, hires a neurotic secretary Sabrina. Knowing that her boyfriend Wayne is a 'baby-phobic', Lena seeks help from Boey, an expert in child behavioral patterns. Finally, Johnny and Wayne overcome a lot of obstacles to bring their 'What babies Want' product line to fruition.....

programme.title: 春心萌動的老屋緣廊
programme.desc: Age is just a number when it comes to being a BL fan! 75-year-old widow Yuki (Nobuko Miyamoto) picks up a boys' love manga one day and it opens her eyes to a new world. At the bookstore, she meets shy 17-year-old schoolgirl Urara (Mana Ashida) who reads BL on the sly. Happily reading and discussing BL together, they forge a congenial bond that heals loneliness and unlocks their inner hopes and fears. Seasoned TV director Shunsuke Kariyama (Love's in Sight) and screenwriter Yoshikazu Okada (The 8-Year Engagement) adapt Kaori Tsurutani's award-winning manga into a heartwarming, female-centric human drama about an unlikely friendship that inspires comfort and change.

programme.title: 超級無敵羊咩咩大電影之天外飛咩
programme.desc: When a visitor from beyond the stars – an impish and adorable alien called LU-LA – crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun soon sees an opportunity for alien-powered fun and adventure, and sets off on a mission to shepherd LU-LA back to her home... Little do the pair know, though, that they are being pursued at every turn by a mysterious alien-hunting government agency, spearheaded by the formidable Agent Red and her bunch of hapless, hazmat-suited goons. Can Shaun and the flock avert Farmageddon on Mossy Bottom Farm before it's too late.

credits.director: 李察菲蘭, 威爾比察

programme.title: 臥底女神團
programme.desc: Shih Tzu is a tough journalist; despite, being a tiny lady with 155cm height. All her life, she's been teased about being so tiny. So, she determines to have a tall boyfriend and when she gets married, she can have tall children. She even wishes to name her baby “Giraffe.” As soon as she meets Faifa, the tallest senior in her university, who becomes a dedicated and hardworking Police Officer, she determines to win his heart. Would she be able to excel in her career and make him fall in love with her.

programme.title: 鐵道英雄
